_meta: Measured while evaluating a fixed log-probability bias on M5 weather probabilities. Validation was used to select the bias; the held-out test split was used once. Numbers were read from make eval / a scratch retrain that mirrored the deployed LightGBM protocol. Nothing here was deployed.

m9_deployed_model.note: Same trained m9_lgbm.pkl; only M5 inputs changed. Applying the post-hoc bias to features the model was not trained on degrades it.

m9_retrained_on_calibrated_features.note: Scratch retrain using the exact deployed protocol (OOF val, 75/25 stratified split, per-class isotonic calibration, 300 trees). Macro-F1 +0.0013 vs deployed; accuracy -0.0062 vs deployed. No clear net gain.

decision: NOT ADOPTED. The M5 standalone gain is real, but it does not transfer to the deployed M9 classifier: applying the bias to M9 inputs regresses macro-F1 to 0.8079, and retraining M9 is a wash (0.8199 / 0.8138 vs 0.8186 / 0.8200). Deploying the bias would also require a matched change in the Android app and a full evidence/PDF cascade for a marginal result. Deployed artifacts are unchanged.
